tasks.short: Stay informed through literature and professional exchange

steps.what: Read current literature, talk with colleagues and participate in professional conferences to stay informed

tasks.design: Retain critical reading and professional exchange, with source material in {DOCS}. A literature summary is not credited with replacing understanding or conference participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional learning requires interpretation and engagement with differing perspectives.
tasks.enabler_now: Search and summary tools exist, but they do not establish removal of the learning named here.
tasks.still_hard: Judge the quality and practical significance of new evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Connect research findings to teaching and social work practice.
tasks.altitude: Improve critical appraisal and professional learning questions.

reach.learn: Separate a new claim from a reliable change in understanding

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers; this does not establish replacement of critical reading or professional exchange.
Retaining professional learning establishes no task labour saving.

assumptions: The teacher reads and interprets publications and discusses developments during s1; no verified relevance or evidence quality flag is assumed.
No separate search administration baseline is invented to reduce actual learning time.
No new tool is deployed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Learning priorities and current literature access
research_questions: Which developments most need critical discussion before they affect teaching?

already_counted.description: Critical reading, colleague discussion and conference participation

incremental.description: No added system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: the professional learning activity remains fully counted, yielding zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues and community agencies to clarify teaching and research issues and develop responses

tasks.design: Retain collaboration as direct work with colleagues and community agencies. A meeting summary does not replace the relationship or joint problem solving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful responses require shared understanding of academic and community constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement for this collaborative judgement is established.
tasks.still_hard: Reconcile different perspectives and develop an acceptable response.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and recognise concerns that a written brief leaves unstated.
tasks.altitude: Improve the clarity and usefulness of joint work.

reach.learn: Translate between practical and academic perspectives

evidence.claim: Collaboration on social work teaching and research remains relationship and judgement work; no task saving is established.

assumptions: Participants clarify the issue and develop responses during s1; no agreed solution or consensus flag is assumed ready.
No scheduling or minute writing baseline is invented for the collaboration itself.
No new deployment or operating process is added, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Nature of community partnerships and recurring issues
research_questions: Which differences in assumptions most often obstruct joint work?

already_counted.description: Issue clarification, relationship work and joint response development

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: collaboration remains fully human, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and career issues after exploring their circumstances

tasks.design: Keep individual academic and career advice with the teacher. Standard course information supports the conversation but does not replace personal guidance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the student's aims and circumstances rather than a standard answer alone.
tasks.enabler_now: No task specific means removes the individual conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Help the student weigh options without assuming a single correct path.
tasks.human_edge: Notice uncertainty and ask questions that help the student make an informed choice.
tasks.altitude: Improve the clarity of choices and appropriate referrals.

reach.learn: Separate factual requirements from personal recommendations

evidence.claim: Individual curricular and career advice remains contextual professional communication; no task labour saving is established.

assumptions: The student supplies goals and circumstances during s1 and the teacher clarifies them; this time remains fully counted.
No eligibility, suitability or career ranking flag is assumed.
No added deployment or operating work means upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Student advice needs and referral arrangements
research_questions: Which recurring uncertainties most affect students' choices?

already_counted.description: Student discussion, option clarification and advice

incremental.description: No added software or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: individual advice remains fully counted, giving zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain student attendance, grades and required records

steps.what: Capture attendance observations and verify grade and record sources against student identifiers
Populate required records from checked attendance, grades and exact source fields
Reconcile attendance and grades, resolve missing records and approve the student record update

tasks.design: Configure native record import and field reuse in {LMS}, keeping source evidence in {DOCS}. The teacher captures attendance and verifies source identity, then approves the exact update after reconciliation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observed attendance and approved marks may be recopied between lists and required records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record functions can reuse checked fields without making new learning judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve identity, absence and grade discrepancies accurately.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently complete record has the wrong context.
tasks.altitude: Own student record quality and correction traceability.

reach.learn: Distinguish missing information from an adverse outcome

evidence.claim: Native field reuse can reduce repeat record entry without producing new grades; this task scenario and savings are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: In s1 the teacher observes and records attendance, supplies student and session identifiers, and verifies grade value, assessment identity, source version and required record fields. Observation, capture, retrieval and missing identity resolution are included in 35 hours.
Existing assessors produce approved grade sources through their unchanged marking process before import; no marking saving is claimed here.
There is no free absence reason, academic standing or competence flag. Unknown reasons remain unknown and discrepancies return to manual correction in s3.

Native functions are checked first. If required grades must also be entered in another institutional system, that write and its checking remain in s3; the design does not assume one system removes the obligation.
Sites already using native transfer have zero incremental saving.
unknowns: Share of records requiring manual clarification
research_questions: Does native reuse reduce effort after attendance capture and every required destination check?

already_counted.description: Attendance and source capture, record reconciliation and approval

incremental.description: Field mapping upkeep and sampled destination reconciliation
Student record interface and access support

approvals.approved_version: Exact student identifiers, sessions, grade values, sources and destination fields; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=60 gives 40 gross and 33 net after 7 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-10 allows required extra destinations, existing imports and retained observation and reconciliation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Improve student record traceability while preserving professional learning, community collaboration and personal advice.
reach: Help administrators distinguish incomplete records from consequential student judgements
role.ambitious_version: A social work teacher with less repeat record entry and preserved time for people, evidence and professional exchange.
